methods.name: with_most_recent_row
methods.signature: fn with_most_recent_row(self, batch: Option<&'a RecordBatch>) -> Self
methods.summary: Sets the most recent input row (see [`Self::most_recent_row`]).

items.name: WindowPhysicalExpressions
items.summary: Stores the physical expressions used inside the `WindowExpr`.

methods.name: aggregate_state
methods.summary: [`Accumulator::state`] if this window function is an aggregate, `None` otherwise (built-in functions like `row_number`, `rank`, `lead`/`lag` have no serializable accumulator state).

methods.name: all_expressions
methods.summary: Returns all expressions used in the [`WindowExpr`]. These expressions are (1) function arguments, (2) partition by expressions, (3) order by expressions.

methods.name: as_any
methods.summary: Returns the window expression as [`Any`] so that it can be downcast to a specific implementation.

methods.name: create_window_fn
methods.summary: Creates a new instance of the window function evaluator.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.summary: Evaluate the window function values against the batch

methods.name: evaluate_args
methods.summary: Evaluate the window function arguments against the batch and return array ref, normally the resulting `Vec` is a single element one.

methods.name: evaluate_stateful
methods.summary: Evaluate the window function against the batch. This function facilitates stateful, bounded-memory implementations.

methods.name: expressions
methods.summary: Expressions that are passed to the WindowAccumulator. Functions which take a single input argument, such as `sum`, return a single [`datafusion_expr::expr::Expr`], others (e.g. `cov`) return many.

methods.name: field
methods.summary: The field of the final result of this window function.

methods.name: get_reverse_expr
methods.summary: Get the reverse expression of this [WindowExpr].

methods.name: get_window_frame
methods.summary: Get the window frame of this [WindowExpr].

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Human readable name such as `"MIN(c2)"` or `"RANK()"`. The default implementation returns placeholder text.

methods.name: order_by
methods.summary: Expressions that's from the window function's order by clause, empty if absent

methods.name: order_by_columns
methods.summary: Get order by columns, empty if absent

methods.name: partition_by
methods.summary: Expressions that's from the window function's partition by clause, empty if absent

methods.name: uses_bounded_memory
methods.summary: Return a flag indicating whether this [WindowExpr] can run with bounded memory.

methods.name: with_new_expressions
methods.signature: fn with_new_expressions(&self, _args: Vec<Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>>, _partition_bys: Vec<Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>>, _order_by_exprs: Vec<Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>>) -> Option<Arc<dyn WindowExpr>>
methods.summary: Rewrites [`WindowExpr`], with new expressions given. The argument should be consistent with the return value of the [`WindowExpr::all_expressions`] method. Returns `Some(Arc<dyn WindowExpr>)` if re-write is supported, otherwise returns `No…

items.name: PartitionBatches
items.summary: The IndexMap (i.e. an ordered HashMap) where record batches are separated for each partition.

items.name: PartitionKey
items.summary: Key for IndexMap for each unique partition
